{"code": "from collections import Counter

# Check distribution of channels
channel_counts = Counter(sales_df['channel'])
print("Channel counts:\n", channel_counts)

# Check conversion rate by channel
conversion_by_channel = sales_df.groupby('channel')['converted'].mean()
print("Conversion rates by channel:\n", conversion_by_channel)

# Compute difference in conversion rates (email - paid_search)
diff_rate = conversion_by_channel['email'] - conversion_by_channel['paid_search']
print(f"Difference in conversion rates (email - paid_search): {diff_rate}")"}
